-- Purpose: 核验日期覆盖范围、每月天数、每日组合完整性
```sql
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', date) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS distinct_days,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS sku_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT region) AS region_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS channel_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sku || region || channel) AS combo_count
FROM data
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```

-- Purpose: 检查复合键唯一性和空值情况
```sql
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT date || sku || region || channel) AS distinct_combo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN refund_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_null_count
FROM data;
```
